chunks: And from him, from Faḍālah, from Sayf, from Abī Bakr, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: When you rise from the first two rakʿahs, then rely upon your two palms and say: By the power of Allah and His strength, I rise and I sit.

key_terms.بِحَوْلِ ٱللَّهِ: by Allah’s power and enabling grace
key_terms.ٱلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the first two units of salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What should be said when rising after the first two rakʿahs in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an etiquette and ruling related to rising after the first two rakʿahs in salat (prayer). It instructs the worshipper to support himself with his palms and to recite a formula expressing dependence upon Allah’s power and strength.
